summary: NEONC Technologies Holdings filed a 424B5 for a registered direct offering of 2,610,715 common shares plus 960,715 pre-funded warrants and 3,571,430 accompanying warrants at a combined $4.20 per share/warrant, raising about $15.0 million before fees. Each warrant is immediately exercisable at $4.20 and expires five years from issuance; pre-funded warrants carry a $0.0001 strike. Nasdaq-listed NTHI last traded at $4.07 on September 8, 2026. Roth Capital Partners and A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners serve as placement agents on a reasonable-best-efforts basis. Proceeds fund working capital and redemption of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock; watch redenomination, exercise overhang and preferred redemption mechanics.
